visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men in casual clothes approach a wooden table, carrying large platters. One holds a high stack of golden-brown flatbreads, while the other presents a large oval dish filled with red curry. A woman in a grey hoodie stands to the left looking at her phone. The background is a restaurant interior with framed pictures and tiled walls. (2) A young man with glasses wearing a purple T-shirt and a black Nike cap sits in front of the food. He gestures enthusiastically towards the camera with both hands, showing the large portions. On the wall behind him is a 'HALAL' sign and a TV screen. Lighting is bright and even. (3) The man begins the eating challenge. He tears pieces of the flatbread, dips them into the curry bowl using a spoon, and eats them rapidly. A digital timer overlay appears in the top right corner. He displays a piece of bread soaked in sauce to the camera, his expression showing enjoyment and focus.
